coordinates(w, i) = i==0 ? w.depot : (w.stops[i].x, w.stops[i].y)
function distance(w, a, b)
    x, y=coordinates(w, a)
    u, v=coordinates(w, b)
    abs(x-u)+abs(y-v)
end
function pathlength(w, path)
    route=[0; path; 0]
    sum(distance(w, route[i], route[i+1]) for i in 1:(length(route)-1))
